The '''Cartao system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Prackla sector/Legends|Prackla sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cartao/Legends|Cartao]].
